name: kahal-tools
description: Technik-Tools für Gemeinden: Livestream, Podcast, Besucherzähler – verknüpft mit dem Planungstool (Planning Center).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker
